77810.subject: $1B Short Squeeze Rockets BTC
77810.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

GM and happy Friday! 

What a week to be in crypto. Bitcoin ripped 18% higher over the last 48 hours, unleashing a massive short squeeze that wiped out over $1B in positions. Between Trump’s White House crypto comments, the strongest ETF inflows since May and macro maneuvers from the US Treasury, the bulls are back in force. 

Meanwhile, the L2 wars are entering a new phase. Robinhood Chain’s explosive honeymoon launch is facing its first real test as Base rebounds. Let’s dive into what’s moving the markets and who’s winning the fight for L2 dominance.

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

BTC is up 18% in just 2 days, and in a space where nearly every asset is a high-beta play on the orange coin, that kind of move tends to ripple violently through the rest of the market (but not the TradFi ones).

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/413b2e7d-6be0-4eeb-b263-117a4e685299/image.png?t=1787301738)
Caption: 

Perps lead the way, up over 28% on the week. This was largely driven by comments from President Trump at the White House crypto meeting, where he said that the CFTC was working to bring Hyperliquid to the US. As mentioned in yesterday’s issue, there was another reason for the broad-based move: the SEC’s proposed rulemaking for [Regulation Crypto Assets](https://www.sec.gov/newsroom/press-releases/2026-76-sec-proposes-new-regulation-crypto-assets). 

There was also a reprieve when the US Treasury said it would at least [double](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/treasury-doubles-long-term-bond-130635805.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com) the size of its long-term government debt buybacks. A surprise move that came at a time of growing strains in the $32T US Treasury market. The administration may be getting nervous about the long end of the curve and clearly wants to stem the decline. The interest expense on US debt hit $1.4T; that’s more than BTC was worth yesterday. Speaking of, let’s turn our attention back to the market leader. 

BTC ETF inflows recorded the highest daily print since May 2026. At this rate, it will also be the largest weekly print since May.

Welcome back! Today: a $2 trillion number nobody will confirm, 100 billion new sources for ChatGPT, agents with trading access and code review moving into a group chat.  In today's Atlas Newsletter: What's Anthropic actually worth? It could file this month and beat SpaceX's $86.2 billion record, on $11.5 billion in quarterly revenue and a $42 billion loss last year. Where do your agent's answers come from? OpenAI's Exa plugin opens 100 billion websites, papers and companies to ChatGPT Work and Codex in about a minute. Would you let an agent place your trades? Binance connected Claude, ChatGPT and Codex to the exchange, with trading scopes and no withdrawal access. Who approves the code now? Slack Code puts agents, diffs and live previews inside a channel, free on every plan. PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? Anthropic is going for the biggest IPO in history  Anthropic could file publicly as soon as the end of this month, and it expects to match or beat the record SpaceX set in June, according to Bloomberg. That record is $75 billion raised, $86.2 billion once the overallotment landed.  Investors are floating a $2 trillion valuation, a figure CFO Krishna Rao declined to engage with in recent briefings. The same company lost roughly $42 billion in 2025.  Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan lined up to run the deal anyway. Ahead of the filing, Anthropic is finalizing a revolving credit facility expected to come in above its roughly $10 billion target.  Dario Amodei and his co-founders are weighing super-voting shares to keep control after listing. 77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!
